create_video_saver: create a VideoSaver instance to save robot episode videos and thinking logs to disk
annotate_image_array: annotate a numpy image array with thinking text overlay using PIL and text wrapping
process_and_save_episode: process buffered frames and thinking text to save original and annotated MP4 videos
get_additional_frame: buffer a camera frame and thinking text with timestamp for later episode video compilation
reset_video_saver: finalize and save the current episode data then clear all buffers for the next episode
